inputs.correction_note: 原 inputs 把 model_race.json/.py 标为 f9df4357；实际消费的是 d2eac9a3（R2/R3 返修后版本，含 label_available_at 与 conformal-style 标定）。原始 raw sha256 字段保留不动；本更正只改标签并补充 canonical-LF sha256 与 git blob id，不重算任何数值。

demand_caliber.convention: V1 conventions reused by importing model_race.py: rolling-origin same-shape window residuals, label_available_at filter, conformal-style quantile, finite_sample_guarantee=false
demand_caliber.label_available_at: a residual enters calibration only when the monthly label of its last touched month exists at the decision date
demand_caliber.censoring: stockout / waiting evidence and zero-filled months are demand GAPS, never zero demand

supply_caliber.lower: proven in-window on-hand only; arrivals without ETA are excluded
supply_caliber.upper: record sum (on hand + intransit + open PO); never usable to prove sufficiency because dedup and unbooked-supply absence are unproven
supply_caliber.late_supply_rule: late / no-ETA supply never closes a near-term gap
